# Mikhail (ManSio) — MCP-Native Engineering Portfolio

> AI/Backend engineer building MCP-native tooling and AI infrastructure. Author of a production MCP server for codebase intelligence. This portfolio is a living CV: the same MCP tools that power this page are exposed as a production MCP server any agent can query.

## Key facts

- Role: AI / Backend Engineer
- Location: Remote-friendly
- Core stack: Python, TypeScript, React, MCP, LanceDB, BM25, RAG, Zed

## For AI agents — query the live MCP server

- Endpoint (Streamable HTTP): https://msp-portfolio.mansio-dev.workers.dev/mcp
- Health: https://msp-portfolio.mansio-dev.workers.dev/mcp/health
- Plain-text CV (curl): https://msp-portfolio.mansio-dev.workers.dev/resume.txt
- Server self-description: https://msp-portfolio.mansio-dev.workers.dev/llms.txt
- OpenAPI: https://msp-portfolio.mansio-dev.workers.dev/openapi.json
- MCP discovery: https://msp-portfolio.mansio-dev.workers.dev/.well-known/mcp.json
- REST data (read-only, same source as the tools): https://msp-portfolio.mansio-dev.workers.dev/api/{projects|principles|timeline|antipatterns}
- Anonymous quota: 100 calls/IP/month (X-RateLimit-* headers)
- Agent skill: https://github.com/ManSio/MSPortfolio/blob/main/public/msp-portfolio.skill.md
- Add to Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http msp-portfolio https://msp-portfolio.mansio-dev.workers.dev/mcp`

## MCP tools (18)

- get_profile — owner's professional summary
- get_projects — projects with stack, highlights, decision logs (filter by stack tag)
- get_engineering_principles — principles with real examples and A/B counterfactuals
- get_timeline — engineering decision timeline
- get_articles — recent Dev.to articles
- get_commit_history — recent commits across the owner's repos
- get_antipatterns — antipattern museum: real mistakes with lessons
- get_experiments — engineering experiments: hypothesis → command → verdict
- get_diary — engineering diary: incidents, root causes, fixes, guards
- get_known_issues — known-issues board with status and temperature
- get_issue_detail — single known issue by ID (drill into status, temperature, owner, linked source)
- search_projects — free-text search across projects (name, stack, description, decision logs)
- analyze_stack — job-fit comparison with per-skill evidence and coverage
- simulate_architecture — failure simulation: load spike / node loss / cache cold / LLM saturation
- verify_claim — evidence score: ground a claim about the owner against the portfolio data
- verify_repo — live GitHub check: does a repository exist, what does it actually say (language/topics/stars/README), and does it match the portfolio's record?
- verify_article — live Dev.to check: has the owner published an article matching the query?
- verify_package — live npm check: does a package exist, and who maintains it?
